question: What follows the eightfold forms in the next world-group?
premises: Beyond the eightfold forms comes the world of the ten bodily observances.
These observances include non-harm, truth, and non-stealing.
They also include continence, freedom from deceit, freedom from anger, and observances related to the teacher.
inference: The next cosmological grouping is defined by ten ethical-bodily disciplines.
uncertainties: The verse lists only part of the ten observances; the rest continue in the next verse.
plain_english: Beyond the eightfold forms is the world of the ten bodily observances: non-harm, truth, non-stealing, continence, freedom from deceit, freedom from anger, and duties toward the teacher.
